Work, WK 98, Op. 16 and recording (La Stagione, CPO/Classic Produktion, 9.5 min) are fine. But the bass is not shown to be an obbligato cello: the 1785 print says 'two for two flutes and a bass', CPO and Grove/Wikipedia say 2 flutes and basso continuo, IMSLP says 'cello (or continuo)'. If it is continuo the scoring should be {flute:2, continuo:1} and there is no string part (out of scope). Same question for sibling 102529 (WK 101).

Print 1774: 'clavecin ou piano forte, avec l'accompagnement de deux violons et violoncello'; Op. 11 No. 2 = WK 54 (B-flat); Sonnerie (Avie, one to a part) 8.4 min, CPO 9.1 min. IMSLP 'WK 5358' is its range format

note: Op. 16 'Abingdon' trios (102528, and sibling 102529 outside this chunk): the bass is 'a bass' in the print and continuo in Grove/CPO, so the cello scoring (and scope, no string part) is open.
